description: Open assembly: assemblyId, assemblyName, vaultLayout, activeId, and parts [{ id, name, visible, missing?, group? }]. Part and assembly ids are opaque surf ids, never a path or display name. No path field. featureCount and bodyCount are on status, not here. featureCount counts insert_* feature blocks, so a freehand set_script is one feature. bodyCount is null until the first run; a finished run that produced no bodies reports 0.
name: parts
